public_study_window: 1999 through the completion of Week 3 of the 2026 season

primary_metric.name: CDCR
primary_metric.definition: Observed conversion rate on the team's last realistic meaningful offensive opportunity when one possession can tie the game or take the lead in the fourth quarter or overtime.
primary_metric.unit: at most one locked viable CDCR opportunity per team-game

selection_rule.backward_search_trigger: Only a qualifying literal-final possession that fails the locked pre-drive viability gate may be skipped backward.
selection_rule.threshold_selection_basis: predeclared threshold sensitivity, low-tail calibration, population stability, and internal blinded pre-drive football-state review
selection_rule.validation_limitation: No independent reviewer was available; limitation disclosed.

difficulty_model.name: xCDCR
difficulty_model.definition: Cross-fitted expected probability that the selected viable CDCR opportunity converts from its start-of-drive situation.

above_expected.name: CAE
above_expected.definition: CDCR minus xCDCR, expressed in percentage points.
above_expected.uncertainty_rule: Confidence intervals must accompany player-level interpretation; an interval crossing zero is not evidence of above-expected performance.

companion_event.name: Clutch Response Event
companion_event.role: descriptive companion; not a replacement rate
companion_event.definition: Any qualifying fourth-quarter/overtime possession that reaches the required score state and is classified as a conversion, including earlier successful qualifying possessions.
companion_event.reporting_rule: Report event counts and case histories, not a response-event success percentage with an outcome-selected denominator.

sdcr_publication_readiness.publication_rule: sCDCR may be published as a descriptive standardization and shrinkage estimate with uncertainty, but not as a demonstrated predictive enhancement over calibrated xCDCR unless both predeclared held-out scoring rules pass.

literal_final_terminal_regime_evidence.note: These diagnostics describe the literal-final decision regime used to train the viability model; they are intentionally validated against the preserved pre-viability baseline.

supersession_sensitivity_decision.reason: Preserving earlier successes while superseding earlier failures makes inclusion outcome-dependent and materially changes rankings.

external_crosswalk.note: Raw Kacsmar-style game-outcome comparison remains the primary external crosswalk; adjusted and all-drive comparisons remain supplemental.

publication_decisions: Methodology v1.2 is the active corrected specification; v1.1 is superseded.
The 5.0% scoring-threat reachability threshold is locked from the predeclared sensitivity set.
Threshold selection used low-tail calibration, population stability, and blinded pre-drive football-state review rather than player ranks.
A second independent blinded human review was not completed because no independent reviewer was available; this is a disclosed validation limitation.
xCDCR remains supplemental and is rebuilt from the locked viable ledger.
CAE is supplemental and must be reported with uncertainty.
Run 88 asymmetric preserved-success formulation remains a sensitivity analysis and is rejected as the primary rate.
Clutch Response Events preserve repeated successful late-game responses descriptively without altering the CDCR denominator.
